w:r.w:t: Make notes to organise your ideas for your narrative adaptation.
Consider how you will keep the elements of the original story, including purpose and audience, when you plan how your characters will act and the settings you choose.

Write notes or ideas about how you will engage the original audience and support the author’s original purpose, for example: what the characters could say or do in your story to contribute to the author’s message or ideas.
Consider how you will experiment with narrative structure,
which may include events that create rising tension or events that lead to a resolution or change in direction for the character.
